_comment: Human decisions for gen_licenses.py (NATIVE-DESKTOP-PLAN.md 26.9). Everything here needs a reason and a basis; the generator refuses an entry without them. It classifies licences mechanically and stops at anything it cannot classify: add a `reviewed` entry ONLY after a person has read the package's licence.

mkl.reason: Intel Simplified Software License: redistributable in binary form with its notice; the notice text is the package's own info/licenses file, shipped in licenses/texts/

tk.reason: Tcl/Tk licence (SPDX TCL): use, copy, modify and distribute for any purpose, no royalty, provided existing copyright notices are retained and the notice is included verbatim in distributions. The package's own text (info/licenses/tcl8.6.13/license.terms) covers the Tcl core; Tk's own terms and the texts of the components tk bundles (zlib1.dll, the SQLite/itcl/tdbc/thread extensions) ship as supplemental_texts
tk.basis: project owner's decision 2026-09-30, NATIVE-DESKTOP-PLAN.md 26.9.7; package text sha256 c0a69a2bfd757361ec7e6143973b103c90409316b49e9c88db26ad6388e79f16; evidence desktop/tools/proposed/TK-BUNDLED-EVIDENCE.md

tzdata.reason: IANA time-zone database, public domain ('all files in the tz code and data ... are in the public domain'). The BSD-3-Clause carve-out names date.c, newstrftime.3 and strftime.c, none of which this build installs (606 files, all share/zoneinfo data; checked against its conda-meta files list)
tzdata.basis: project owner's decision 2026-09-30, NATIVE-DESKTOP-PLAN.md 26.9.7; package text info/licenses/LICENSE sha256 0613408568889f5739e5ae252b722a2659c02002839ad970a63dc5e9174b27cf

gmsh.reason: GPL-2.0-or-later; allowed only in the separate optional add-on runtime, never in the base installer

tetgen.reason: wraps TetGen, AGPL-3.0; allowed only in the separate optional add-on runtime, never in the base installer

embedded.reason: header-only MIT code compiled into tcad_desktop.exe (no DLL), so it is listed explicitly (section 7.3 table)

libsqlite.reason: the archive ships no licence file; SQLite is public domain and the only text carried with the code is the header blessing

texts.source: lines 1-9 of Library/include/sqlite3.h inside libsqlite-3.53.4-hf5d6505_1.conda (archive sha256 0a45d7c0...26ad), verbatim

libwinpthread.reason: the archive ships no licence file although its recipe declares these two; conda's expression is 'MIT AND BSD-3-Clause-Clear' and COPYING carries both (mingw-w64 MIT terms and the derived-pthreads notice)
libwinpthread.basis: project owner's decision 2026-09-30, NATIVE-DESKTOP-PLAN.md 26.9.7; texts taken at the recipe's own source revision (info/recipe/meta.yaml: git_url github.com/mingw-w64/mingw-w64, git_rev dc42231f0)

pyamg.reason: this build's archive has no info/licenses; about.json declares MIT. The text is the same release's, from the sibling build _2 (not swapped in: its compiled .pyd differ)

texts.source: info/licenses/LICENSE.txt inside pyamg-5.3.0-py314hbac2fa4_2.conda (archive sha256 426c4510...5a46), identical to the project's LICENSE.txt

libfreetype6.reason: 'GPL-2.0-only OR FTL', used under the FTL; the archive ships no text. FTL section 2 requires crediting the FreeType Team in the documentation: `notice` is the FTL's own suggested wording, year from freetype.h 2.14.3 ("Copyright (C) 1996-2026")
libfreetype6.notice: Portions of this software are copyright (c) 2026 The FreeType Project (https://freetype.org).  All rights reserved.

texts.source: info/licenses/docs/FTL.TXT inside freetype-2.14.3-h57928b3_2.conda (same recipe and version; archive sha256 32f7dd8f...3efd), byte-identical to upstream

tk.reason: the package text covers the Tcl core only; these are Tk's own terms and the texts of the components tk bundles (TK-BUNDLED-EVIDENCE.md)
tk.basis: project owner's decision 2026-09-30, NATIVE-DESKTOP-PLAN.md 26.9.7; from tcl8.6.13-src.tar.gz (sha256 43a1fae7...f066) and tk8.6.13-src.tar.gz (sha256 2e65fa06...0675)
